steps.name: the runner really is a graphical login session
launch TextEdit
steps.comment: `open` goes through LaunchServices, which needs no Apple Events authorisation, and it already creates an untitled document. `tell application "TextEdit" to activate` would raise a modal and block.

steps.name: a document window is up
steps.comment: Read through System Events. Talking to TextEdit directly needs Apple Events authorisation.
steps.exec: osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to count windows of process "TextEdit"' | awk '$1 >= 1 { print "window-present" }'

steps.comment: A freshly focused window drops the first keystrokes.

steps.name: both lines landed, so Return was not swallowed
steps.exec: osascript -e 'with timeout of 20 seconds' -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell process "TextEdit" to get value of text area 1 of scroll area 1 of window 1' -e 'end timeout' | tr '\r' '\n' | grep -ci 'line' | tr -d ' '
